ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large irregular high-intensity (white) region occupying the distal two-thirds of the left lobe; right lobe is predominantly low-intensity (black) with high-intensity (white) mottling and small focal spots concentrated near the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations between 3 and 15 pixels along the distal boundaries of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex curve toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete high-contrast white circular pixel clusters distributed across the dark regions of the right lobe and scattered within the mottled regions of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial-distal portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle colonization visible as high-contrast, jagged clusters at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, altering the expected smooth boundary of the trailing edge.
